question: What changes when the frozen full routing trajectory is exchanged between uniform-baseline and supplied-answer states, while native experts recompute their outputs?
source_scope: The original design was fixed locally before computation. The first audit stopped on a metadata-schema error before outcome scoring; source review found a second error. A separately frozen saved-data audit corrected only those assumptions and checked the unchanged complete panel. Original STOP remains. This is retrospective audit correction, not original completion or public preregistration. The reading bundle includes47 frozen Python files and original failure plus corrected audit records; raw tensors, prior studies and model weights are not bundled. It is not a self-contained reproduction.
methods: At all four native routers in blocks20..23, first compute and retain the actual native five-member tuple. For four controlled arms return byte-exact source order,token indices,BF16 gates and expert counts plus the identical live logits object. Native expert linears, nonlinearities, summation, residuals, attention, final norm and vocabulary head all recompute on current inputs. No expert or branch output is replayed.
primary_outcome: J = target logit minus arithmetic mean of the other seven fixed candidate logits. Target and candidate token IDs come unchanged from the earlier source plan. Preserve all seven target-minus-other contrasts, strict unique eight-label choice and target-minus-best-other margin as secondary outcomes.
drift_note: Full per-cell final/nonfinal branch, expert-input and residual drift is retained in the full report in the reading bundle.
audit_correction: Require the native device descriptor mps:0, not mps.

Require a single BF16[1,16,L,L] attention auxiliary descriptor with a valid SHA256, unchanged before/after and object preservation; not [None]. Historical controls still require exact original descriptors.
interpretation: With the organ-written signal present, restoring the baseline expert routes kept all 96 answers correct, with no ties. Changed routing was therefore not necessary to preserve these choices under this specific four-block intervention.

Normal written routes raised the target score relative to the mean of the other seven answer scores by 0.9612 on average compared with baseline routes on the same written input. The effect was positive in 78 cases and negative in 18; it was not uniformly helpful.

Moving the written routes onto the baseline signal produced 12/96 correct choices with 3 ties, compared with 10/96 and 12 ties for the baseline. That routing policy did not reproduce the full 96/96 result without the written signal.

The separate corrected audit admitted all 192 native replications and 192 same-route controls before calculating any route-cross outcome. A further independent terminal recount matched all 576 saved score vectors, 96 cell contrast/drift records and pooled/per-world summaries.

The original audit stopped on a device-descriptor mismatch; source review found a second attention-auxiliary schema error. A separately frozen saved-data correction repaired those assumptions with no model rerun, new fit, paid call or numerical-rule change. The original run remains stopped.

This result concerns the entire implemented routing policy across the full sequence and last four blocks: expert selections, mixing weights, grouping and resulting numerical effects. Experts still recomputed outputs from current inputs.

The signal already carries the answer and all 96 context/world cases were exposed. This identifies a conditional effect on answer scores, not semantic reasoning, calibration, an energy-model advantage, new-world transfer, a unique mechanism or novelty.
limits: The entire implemented full-sequence routing trajectory, jointly identities and coefficients. Group sizes, token order and resulting arithmetic are included. This does not isolate final-token-only semantics, selection versus coefficients, a specific expert, or an ideal real-number intervention.

A route clamp can reveal dependence of this engineered answer channel on this policy. It cannot refute the earlier branch-clamp shortcut, establish computation transfer, partial-information composition, planning, energy-model superiority, unseen-rule transfer or novelty. Written-source routes were generated using the organ answer and may themselves carry that answer. All24contexts/fourworlds are exposed repeated development cases.

Retain full attention/MoE branch outputs and existing full MoE inputs/final residual. Audit consistency with observed final rows/nonfinal hashes. Report crossed-arm drift relative to same-input native run at every block and final residual; a numeric side effect is included in this implemented-policy effect, not silently excluded.
Exact rational finite differences are descriptive over96 exposed cells/24 contexts/four worlds; no p-values, mediator fractions or population inference.
Later parent terminal review binds the new owner monitor/log after cleanup. The original complete file inventory is bound before and after this saved-data audit.
